reshape.reason: General rank-changing reshape requires coordinate linearization/delinearization, including division/modulo of coordinates. Current calculated reads support addition, scaling, offsets, selection and reversal only.

concatenate.reason: Concatenation needs coordinate-dependent branch selection and reads with shifted coordinates. Scalar select operates on values, and cannot test logical coordinates. Semantic operation operands cannot be variadic.

pad.reason: Padding requires coordinate bounds predicates and selecting a valid input read or padding value. Scalar select cannot test logical coordinates, and calculated reads do not support coordinate-dependent branches.

nonnegative_pad.reason: Padding requires coordinate bounds predicates and selecting a valid input read or padding value. Scalar select cannot test logical coordinates, and calculated reads do not support coordinate-dependent branches.

dynamic_slice.reason: Tensor index values cannot be used as calculated-read coordinates. Updates/scatter also need piecewise writes or gather-style inverse indexing; variadic starts cannot be semantic operands.

reduce.reason: Opaque region handles cannot be interpreted as scalar value functions. Arbitrary combiners and their initializers cannot be replaced with sum semantics.

convert.reason: Numeric conversions require rounding/truncation/fixed-width value semantics. A dtype contract alone does not describe conversion values.
